text_en: The sin of Judah is written with an iron pen; with a diamond point it is engraved on the tablet of their hearts, and on the horns of their altars,
text_cn: 犹大的罪是用铁笔记录下来的，用钻石尖刻在他们的心坎上和他们的祭坛角上，

text_en: while their children remember their altars and their sacred poles, beside every green tree, and on the high hills,
text_cn: 好叫他们的子孙记得他们在高岗上，青绿树下和平原的山上，设立了祭坛和神木。

text_en: on the mountains in the open country. Your wealth and all your treasures I will give for spoil as the price of your sin throughout all your territory.
text_cn: 你的财产和所有的宝藏，我必使人掠夺，以抵偿你在全境内犯过的一切罪恶。

text_en: By your own act you shall lose the heritage that I gave you, and I will make you serve your enemies in a land that you do not know, for in my anger a fire is kindled that shall burn forever.
text_cn: 我必由你手中撤回我赐与你的产业，叫你在不相识的地方给你敌人为奴，因为我的怒火已燃起，永燃不熄。

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Cursed are those who trust in mere mortals and make mere flesh their strength, whose hearts turn away from the Lord .
text_cn: 上主这样说：“凡信赖世人，以血肉的人为自己的臂膊，决心远离上主的人，是可咒骂的！

text_en: They shall be like a shrub in the desert, and shall not see when relief comes. They shall live in the parched places of the wilderness, in an uninhabited salt land.
text_cn: 他必像一株在旷野中的柽(chēng)柳，即使幸福来到，一点也不觉察，只住在旷野干燥处，满含盐质无人居住之地。

text_en: Blessed are those who trust in the Lord , whose trust is the Lord .
text_cn: 凡信赖上主，以上主作依靠的人，是可祝福的：

text_en: They shall be like a tree planted by water, sending out its roots by the stream. It shall not fear when heat comes, and its leaves shall stay green; in the year of drought it is not anxious, and it does not cease to bear fruit.
text_cn: 他必像一株栽在水边的树木，生根河畔，不怕炎热的侵袭，枝叶茂盛，不愁旱年，不断结实。

text_en: The heart is devious above all else; it is perverse— who can understand it?
text_cn: 人心最狡猾欺诈，已不可救药；谁能透识？

text_en: I the Lord test the mind and search the heart, to give to all according to their ways, according to the fruit of their doings.
text_cn: 我上主究察人心，考验肺腑，依照各人的行径和作为的结果，给人报酬。

text_en: Like the partridge hatching what it did not lay, so are all who amass wealth unjustly; in mid-life it will leave them, and at their end they will prove to be fools.
text_cn: 谁不以正义积聚财物，像一只鹧鸪孵化不是自己产的卵，中途必要抛弃；结果，还是自己糊涂。

text_en: O glorious throne, exalted from the beginning, shrine of our sanctuary!
text_cn: 我们圣所的地方，从起初就是设在崇高之处的光荣宝座。

text_en: O hope of Israel! O Lord ! All who forsake you shall be put to shame; those who turn away from you shall be recorded in the underworld, for they have forsaken the fountain of living water, the Lord .
text_cn: 上主，以色列的希望！凡离弃你的，必要蒙羞；上主，凡远离你的，必被记录在地上，因为他们离弃了活水的泉源。

text_en: Heal me, O Lord , and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved; for you are my praise.
text_cn: 上主，求你医治我，我必能痊愈；你拯救我，我必能获救，因为你是我的荣耀。

text_en: See how they say to me, “Where is the word of the Lord ? Let it come! ”
text_cn: 看啊，世人对我说：上主的话在哪里？让它来吧！

text_en: But I have not run away from being a shepherd in your service, nor have I desired the fatal day. You know what came from my lips; it was before your face.
text_cn: 至于我，我没有强迫你加害，也没有愿望灾祸的日子；你知道：凡出自我口的，都先向你面陈过。

text_en: Do not become a terror to me; you are my refuge in the day of disaster;
text_cn: 请你不要成为我的恐怖，你原是我患难之日的避难所。

text_en: Let my persecutors be shamed, but do not let me be shamed; let them be dismayed, but do not let me be dismayed; bring on them the day of disaster; destroy them with double destruction!
text_cn: 愿迫害我的人蒙羞，而不是我蒙羞；愿他们惊慌，而不是我惊慌；请你给他们招来灾祸的日子，以双倍的毁灭，消灭他们。

text_en: Thus said the Lord to me: Go and stand in the People’s Gate, by which the kings of Judah enter and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem,
text_cn: 上主这样对我说：“你去立在犹大君王出入的本雅明门前，立在耶路撒冷各门前，

text_en: and say to them: Hear the word of the Lord , you kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, who enter by these gates.
text_cn: 向他们说：犹大的君王、全体犹大人和耶路撒冷居民，即凡由这些门进来的，你们聆听上主的话！

text_en: Thus says the Lord : For the sake of your lives, take care that you do not bear a burden on the sabbath day or bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem.
text_cn: 上主这样说：你们应该小心，不要在安息日担运重载，进入耶路撒冷的城门。

text_en: And do not carry a burden out of your houses on the sabbath or do any work, but keep the sabbath day holy, as I commanded your ancestors.
text_cn: 不要在安息日从你们的家里搬运重载；不要做任何工作，却要按照我曾给你们祖先所吩咐的，圣化安息日。

text_en: Yet they did not listen or incline their ear; they stiffened their necks and would not hear or receive instruction.
text_cn: 他们不但不侧耳倾听，反而硬着颈项，不愿依从，不愿受教。

text_en: But if you listen to me, says the Lord , and bring in no burden by the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but keep the sabbath day holy and do no work on it,
text_cn: 设若你们认真听从我──上主的断语──在安息日，不将重担搬进这城门，却圣化安息日，不做任何工作；

text_en: then there shall enter by the gates of this city kings who sit on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their officials, the people of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city shall be inhabited forever.
text_cn: 那么，坐在达味宝座上的君王和王侯，便会乘车骑马，与自己的公卿、犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民，从这城的门进来；这城必永远有人居住；

text_en: And people shall come from the towns of Judah and the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, from the Shephelah, from the hill country, and from the Negeb, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, grain offerings and frankincense, and bringing thank offerings to the house of the Lord .
text_cn: 人们从犹大各城、耶路撒冷四周、本雅明地、平原、山地和南方前来，带着全燔祭、牺牲、素祭和乳香，在上主的殿里奉献感恩祭。

text_en: But if you do not listen to me, to keep the sabbath day holy, and to carry in no burden through the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day, then I will kindle a fire in its gates; it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem and shall not be quenched.
text_cn: 但是，如果你们不听从我，不圣化安息日，反在安息日担运重载，进入耶路撒冷的城门，我必在城门口放火，叫火吞灭耶路撒冷的宫殿，决不熄灭。”
